notes.title: Giant Life - Release!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868207/00071bfdf1371b6f57fd59dd9f86c132b4b5cd11.gif
Well hello guys!
Today we are releasing the version 1.0 of Giant Life, a VR physic puzzle game.
Play as an angry giant through a virtual reality journey, exploring the realm, destroying settlements and frightening its inhabitants.

Main features:

 5 special throwable projectiles.
 22 unique levels.
 More than 50 destructible structures.
 Finger tracking for Valve Index, HTC Vive and Oculus rift controllers.
 Vikings, Knights and Pirates.
 Cute low poly graphics.


Suggestions:
We hope you guys enjoy the game, and if you have any suggestions leave them in the suggestion section in the community hub:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1081250/discussions/2/

Bug reports
If you find any bugs feel free to report them in the community hub section.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1081250/discussions/0/

Discord
Come gather around a Giant Life! We'll be having weekly contest and giveaways!
Join us on Discord!

notes.title: Giant Life: The final countdown + Pre-Release Giveaways!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868207/5930b08d579f88c1d0d63c22805f5a3dbfe8d6a3.gif
Hello there guys!
We are very happy to announce that Giant Life is now officially out of beta.
Now we are on the final countdown until release: June 7th.

Also we have a special announcement to make:
During the course of the week we will be selecting players that comment and like this post, and they will receive a free copy of the game for testing purposses!

Start smashing that like button and comment bellow! ːcamperː

The Patagoniart Team.

notes.title: VECITAS 1.0 - RELEASED TODAY!
notes.content:
Well guys, today as promised we've released Vecitas version 1.0. We are now officialy out of Beta.

notes.title: TRADING CARDS, INVENTORY AND LEAVING BETA.
notes.content:
Well, hello guys. Hope you've been doing well. Here at the studios we are quite happy with the results the beta is having so far.  Plenty got tested, servers have been modified on the user end, and we've polished what we've thought needed addressing. 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28050389/5b200278a4e3ffaa09a217c1ac9a9e272c6f73fa.png

STEAM TRADING CARDS:

Starting tomorrow the game will count with Steam Trading Cards. A full set of seven cards. The full  Colmena System's ships. 
About the Colmena System: This system is a singleplayer level, where the player will seek and destroy the enemy Colmena ships. Each time the player manages to kill one ship, he will unlock that skin through the achievement system.

UPCOMING INVENTORY SYSTEM:

We've started the development process of adding tradeable items in game. 
How can we get will get the items? 
We will grant clients playing multiplayer items such as Ship Skins, Custom map backgrounds, Dark Matter and access to Wormholes.
We will give out more information about these items when we get closer to release them public.

LEAVING BETA:

After running the Beta for three weeks, we've gathered plenty of valuable information about the game, collected feedback from you guys, and we've tried to address them as soon as we could.

So when will we release the Full Game?
Decemeber 22th, 2020 is the date!











No, we are kidding! 
The game will leave the Beta State on: April 12th, 2017.

The Patagoniart Team
ːcamperː

notes.title: UPDATE - 1.05
notes.content:
Well guys, we've been working hard this past week on changing game mechanics and most of all improving the multiplayer. Without further rambling here are the patch notes:

 Vecitas Beta - 1.05

Changed completely the multiplayer p2p protocol. We're now relaying on SteamMatchmaking. 
Added help UI in Singleplayer mode for those who were a bit confused about the goal of singleplayer.
Corrected minor bugs.
Corrected minor glitches on interfaces.
Corrected glitches on ingame.


We hope you guys enjoy the patch, and if you find any bugs report them in the "Bug Report" section.

The Patagoniart Team

notes.title: UPDATE - 1.02
notes.content:
Well guys, we've been working hard this past week on fixing bugs, tweaking game mechanics and adding features to the game. Without further rambling here are the patch notes:

 Vecitas Beta - 1.02

Optimized the multiplayer sendratio to adjust the positions of players in game.
Corrected bug that made the singleplayer ships die while having gravitational power.
Corrected bug that spawned enemy debuffs out of place.
Added optimizations for lower CPUs. Change the quality in the main menu (Options), to play the game smoothly according to your hardware.
Balanced the multiplayers plasma points spawns.


We hope you guys enjoy the patch, and if you find any bugs report them in the "Bug Report" section.

The Patagoniart Team

notes.title: Vecitas - Public Beta now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Today we happy to announce that we are releasing Vecitas Beta to public in Steam Early Access.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28050389/48034a9d9b8a90987d25f5a01ceb57e0b8f7b113.png

 What is Vecitas? 
Vecitas is a multiplayer game that merges singleplayer gamemode with multiplayer. Unlock all the ships in the singleplayer and engage in deep space combat with other players.

 How long will the beta last? 
In the upcoming months, we are going to be tweaking and optimizing the game servers to provide you guys with hours of multiplayer fun.

 Do you have to pay for skins? 
No, that's the best part of this game, all the skins coming and to come, will be obtainable by playing online or singleplayer.

If you find any bugs, or want to suggest a change for the game, leave your ideas and feedback in our community forums:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/555830/discussions/

Don't miss out and try Vecitas Beta today!
